linework.observation: Clean bold contours define the bald protagonist, chart table, hatch and control panel.

colour.observation: Muted steel, navy, cream and soft blue; color balance remains natural.

shading.observation: Soft cel shading on the figure and equipment; no obvious material mismatch.

character_construction.observation: Bald protagonist has the canonical rounded head and facial features.

backgrounds.observation: Submarine chart room is detailed, but a large open circular hatch shows bright sky or water.

finish.observation: Crisp illustrated forms and legible chart-room equipment.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls match the current level.

content.observation: FAIL: a chart-room opening shows bright exterior sky or water, repeating an impossible external view inside the submerged interior.

composition.observation: Wide full-body framing keeps the protagonist and chart table visible with headroom.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist writing in a notebook.
regions.architecture: Ladder and piping; large round open hatch shows exterior blue light.
regions.distance: Chart table and equipment add depth.
regions.lighting: Warm cabin lamps mix with exterior daylight from the hatch.

correction: Keep the protagonist writing at the chart table in the same room. Replace the open circular hatch with an opaque sealed steel hatch; show no sky, water or exterior light. Preserve the bald identity, coveralls, chart and illustrated style.
